newsitem.title: CHINA: China aims to produce 25 bln cu m/yr gas by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China aims to produce 25 bln cu m/yr gas by 2000.

text.p: China aims to produce 25 billion cubic metres of natural gas by the year 2000 and 30 billion cubic metres by 2005, the official Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

China was expected to verify additional onshore natural gas reserves of 1.0 trillion cubic metres by 2000, or double the current amount, Xinhua quoted an official of the China National Petroleum Corp as saying.
An international project to build a natural gas pipeline through China, the Korean peninsula and Japan would eventually pipe some 25 billion cubic metres of gas a year to China, the official said.

China was also involved in a joint venture with Russia to develop natural gas in Siberia, a project expected to supply another 25 billion cubic metres a year, the official said but gave no further details.
China's natural gas output totalled 18.2 billion cubic metres between January and November 1996, up nearly 16 percent from the same 1995 period, the latest official figures show.
